title: Fisher–Rao Geodesic Attention: Exact Constant-Curvature Kernels for Sequence Models at Near-Matmul Cost
description: Preprint and fully reproducible codebase (CPU). Attention mechanisms whose similarity is the exact Fisher–Rao geodesic distance between distributional token representations: categorical tokens yield a spherical kernel, isotropic Gaussian tokens yield a genuinely hyperbolic kernel computable at near-matmul cost. Includes 20-seed statistics, a 46x scale probe, a threshold-gated parameter-efficiency result, a pre-registered natural-data length-extrapolation result, and seven pre-specified negative results reported in full.
